label: Gulf Coast 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's Gulf Coast crack spread: three barrels of MEH crude producing two barrels of USGC CBOB gasoline and one barrel of USGC ULSD.

label: Mid-Continent 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's Mid-Continent crack spread: three barrels of WTI crude producing two barrels of Chicago CBOB gasoline and one barrel of Chicago ULSD.

label: West Coast 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's West Coast crack spread: three barrels of ANS crude producing two barrels of LA CARBOB and one barrel of LA CARB Diesel.

label: Blended 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's blended crack spread: the Gulf Coast, Mid-Continent and West Coast crack spreads, weighted by MPC's refining capacity by region in each period.

label: NYMEX 3:2:1 crack spread
definition: The exchange-traded crack spread: three NYMEX WTI crude oil futures against two RBOB gasoline futures and one NY Harbor ULSD futures. Not one of MPC's benchmarks.

label: USGC 3-2-1 MEH Crack, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published USGC 3-2-1 crack: three barrels of MEH crude against two barrels of Gulf Coast CBOB and one of Gulf Coast ULSD, with the RVO cost deducted from each product barrel.

label: CHI 3-2-1 Crack WTI, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published Chicago 3-2-1 crack: three barrels of WTI crude against two barrels of Chicago CBOB and one of Chicago ULSD, with the RVO cost deducted from each product barrel.

label: Group 3-2-1 Crack WTI, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published Group 3 (Tulsa) 3-2-1 crack: three barrels of WTI crude against two barrels of Group 3 CBOB and one of Group 3 ULSD, with the RVO cost deducted from each product barrel.

label: LA 3-2-1 Crack ANS, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published LA 3-2-1 crack: three barrels of ANS crude against two barrels of LA gasoline and one of LA ULSD, with the RVO cost deducted from each product barrel.

label: PNW 3-2-1 Crack, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published PNW 3-2-1 crack, an ANS crack by its MIPS group, with the RVO cost deducted. The definition does not list its input legs.

label: SLC 3-2-1 Crack WTI, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' published SLC 3-2-1 crack, a WTI crack, with the RVO cost deducted. The definition does not list its input legs.

label: Blended 3-2-1 Crack, ex-RIN
definition: MPC Economics' MPC-weighted 3-2-1: the USGC, Chicago and LA ex-RIN cracks weighted to approximate a realized MPC 3-2-1.

label: MPC Internal Blended 3-2-1 Crack, ex-RIN
definition: The second published result of MPC Economics' MPC-weighted 3-2-1, from the same three ex-RIN cracks. The definition does not say how it differs from the Blended 3-2-1 Crack, ex-RIN.
